meta.notes: Chronicle templates for the road pack (world-2 L1, iter-112 — the tavern grammar reskinned; speed over distinctiveness, the loop change is the test). Syntax unchanged: {slot} binds event data; #symbol# expands the tracery grammar; {cond?a|b} is ink-style conditional text; lists = alternatives via the ink-shuffle ShufflePool (cosmetic stream). tale_gate.min_importance decides which events earn a chronicle line (the importance rule owns the split, the gate follows). The world_history line's formed arm binds the five armed claim slots (terrain/near_river/ground/watch_height/far_region).

events.examine_failed: {actor} squints at {target}, unsure what to make of it.
events.take_failed: {target?{actor} reaches for {target} — and is noticed.|{actor} reaches for the {texture_slot} — and is noticed.}
events.pickpocket_failed: {actor}'s hand drifts toward {target}'s purse — {target} notices the movement.
events.smoke_rising: Smoke fills {location}; it is getting hard to see.
events.location_burned_out: {location} burns out. Nothing will be the same here.
events.watch_change: {outgoing?The watch changes: {outgoing} hands the post to {incoming}.|The watch changes: {incoming} takes the post.}
events.document_check: {actor} demands papers from {target} — the papers do not satisfy.
events.document_check_failed: {actor} demands papers from {target} — the answer satisfies.
events.arrest_resolved: {caught?{target} is caught — the pursuit holds.|{target} slips away.}
events.expectation_violation: {actor} checks on {target} — it is not where it should be.
events.coerce: {actor} leans on {target} — the hold is spent.
events.ramble: {actor} rambles to no one in particular.
events.conclusion_drawn: {actor} had noticed it before, and named it: {knows}.
events.world_history: {year?{actor} remembers: {kind}, in the year {year}{participants?, between {participants}}{places?, at site {places}}{collection?, in the {collection}}.|{actor} takes shape: {sites} sites, {regions} regions, {years} years{terrain?, {terrain} ground}{near_river?, river near}{ground?, {ground} yard}{watch_height?, the toll post {watch_height} paces above the water}{far_region?, {far_region} country}.}
